Outcome.DescriptionText: Your team is surrounded by a gang that asks for a little of your time. Your engineers repair their captured ships. In return they gift you a small flotilla.
Your troops make contact with local smugglers. After hours of talks they will be permitted to carry on, as long as they pay tax on what they make.
Your troops contact a group of assassins. They are allowed to carry on their business and in return promise help if the planet is invaded.
Deep below is a factory where weapons and ammunition are made for Orion pirate ships. The foreman employs pit slaves and is very comfortable with it.
Outcome.ConfirmText: This is not the Federation way

Outcome.DescriptionText: Tensions rise and a pirate faction is angry that the underhive will no longer pay protection money. Your troops retreat. As they leave a rebel ship opens fire.
